rooms.suppression: S1/S2 are optional candidate fire-suppression heads, not validated coverage. Agent, count, location and release logic require per-hazard decisions. Independent non-potable supply; no tie to drinking water. Inhibits, local/manual release and agent-specific evacuation/occupancy handling unresolved.
rooms.network: Wired jack, local sensor bus and RF AP are separate logical interfaces. RF protocol/frequency/coverage unresolved; emergency alarm/control must retain a local path on network loss.
